name: Sendbridge API
description:
Sendbridge API v2 is the current public API.

**Authentication** uses `Authorization: Bearer sbk_live_…` or `sbk_test_…`. Never put the key in the URL.

**Test keys** (`sbk_test_`) return realistic fixture responses and never charge credits. Start there while you integrate.

**Live keys** (`sbk_live_`) run the real checks and debit your credit balance.

Create keys in the [app dashboard](https://app.sendbridge.com/api-keys).

The previous `/v1/validate` endpoint still works but is frozen. Migrate to `POST /validation/verify`.
